customer_updates.text:
Extremely unprofessional experience at Dolphin Yamaha, Sakinaka. My Yamaha Aerox 155 has run only 4,654 km and is under standard warranty. During the 2nd free service, it had a starting issue diagnosed as a faulty Starter Relay.
​Despite the part being clearly listed in the Yamaha Protection Plus warranty list (Sr. No. 38), the service center denied warranty and charged me ₹746 (Relay + Labor).
​Major issues observed:
​Unfair Charges: Taking money for a warranty part and charging labor on a 'Free Service' job card.
​OBD Contradiction: They claim the OBD scanner showed 'Normal' with no error codes, yet they insisted on replacing the relay and charging me for it.
​Hidden Charges: They charge for "Consumables" like cotton and grease, but none were actually used on the vehicle.
​Poor Service: I had to visit 3 times for a simple relay issue.
​I have paid the bill 'Under Protest' and mentioned the same on the Job Card. Escalating this to Yamaha India with all technical reports and invoices. Suggest everyone to double-check their warranty terms before paying here!

featured_reviews.name: ravi solanki
featured_reviews.review_text:
I would like to bring to your notice a very disappointing and unacceptable experience I had at Dolphin Yamaha Service Center, Sakinaka.

On 13/12/2025 at around 10:30 AM, I handed over my Yamaha bike at the above-mentioned service center for servicing and replacement of certain parts. A job card was created, and I was informed that the total estimated cost would be ₹15,604 + GST. I was asked to leave the bike and collect it by 5:30 PM, to which I agreed.

However, when I visited the service center between 5:30 PM and 6:00 PM to collect my bike, I was shocked to see that no work had been done on my bike throughout the entire day. My bike had just been kept there without any servicing or repairs.

When I questioned the staff regarding this, they failed to provide any proper explanation and instead behaved in a very rude, unprofessional, and disrespectful manner. I felt completely ignored, and the way I was treated was extremely pathetic and unacceptable.

Due to this behavior, I was forced to take my bike back without any service being done. This is honestly the worst service experience I have ever had, and it has severely affected my trust in Yamaha. I am now genuinely reconsidering my decision to continue owning a Yamaha bike due to such poor customer handling.

I kindly request Yamaha to investigate this matter seriously and take strict action against the concerned service center so that other customers do not have to face such treatment in the future.

It has already been more than 20 days, and I still haven’t received my bike. On top of that, they are asking for another 20–30 days.

This is extremely unprofessional and careless service. They don’t take responsibility and just keep delaying without fixing the actual problem.

My personal Advice: Think twice before choosing this service center. It will waste your time, money, and patience.

Jawa Showroom, Santacruz West

I immediately contacted the concerned service representative from your showroom and explained the issue. He informed me that someone would inspect the bike and arrange for it to be picked up. Unfortunately, despite repeated follow-ups over the last 10 days, I have neither received any update nor any assistance from your team.
